scope: Independent static source and metadata review. No clinical or Quest Play validation.
findings: The generator animation input allowlist contains only source_annotations.json, rig_bind_geometry.json and text_evidence.json.
All input paths are within the isolated demonstration output folder. No external recorded tracking CSV, existing HandPoseData pose values or earlier draft pose/trajectory is an animation input.
Generic SDK bind geometry supplies hand model structure, not expert motion.
Observed video keys are manual image-plane wrist/palm annotations; depth is explicitly fixed at z=0.
550 pixels per model unit is an authored view scale, not physical calibration.
Finger flexion, thumb flexion, twist and between-key easing are authored display choices.
Text evidence supplies contact and support descriptions; no numeric clinical pass angle is derived.
The generator writes only its named files in the separate Captures folder. It has no existing Resources, scene, config or assessment write target.
Existing protected files were additionally read as opaque SHA256 streams for preservation checks; this is not zero filesystem access to those files.
